title: Night sounds
text:
When the sun has gone to bed
and the moon shines overhead,
I snuggle down and close my eyes
to hear the night's soft lullabies.

A frog goes croak beside the pond,
and crickets chirp in the grass beyond.
A gecko clicks upon the wall,
and drip, drip, drop, the raindrops fall.

A dog next door gives one small bark,
an owl hoots softly in the dark.
The night is busy, I can tell,
but I am sleepy now. Sleep well!
